dancer.en: The dancer practiced the final routine carefully before the school performance began.
dancer.zh: 那位舞者在校內表演開始前仔細練習最後一段舞步。

dawn.en: We reached the mountain viewpoint just before dawn painted the sky pale orange.
dawn.zh: 我們在黎明把天空染成淡橘色前抵達了山上的觀景點。

dazzle.en: The bright stage lights can dazzle performers if they look directly at them.
dazzle.zh: 如果表演者直視明亮的舞台燈光，可能會感到目眩。

deadly.en: Scientists study deadly diseases carefully to understand how they spread and can be prevented.
deadly.zh: 科學家仔細研究致命疾病，以了解它們如何傳播以及如何預防。

deaf.en: The school installed visual alarms to support deaf students during emergencies.
deaf.zh: 學校安裝了視覺警報，以在緊急情況下協助聽障學生。

deafen.en: Extremely loud sounds can deafen people temporarily, so hearing protection is important.
deafen.zh: 極大的聲響可能暫時使人失去聽覺，因此保護聽力很重要。

debut.en: The young singer made her debut at a local music festival last summer.
debut.zh: 那位年輕歌手去年夏天在地方音樂節首次登台。

decisive.en: Her decisive response helped the team solve the problem before the deadline.
decisive.zh: 她果斷的回應幫助團隊在截止日前解決問題。

declaration.en: The club released a declaration explaining its goals for the coming school year.
declaration.zh: 社團發布了一份聲明，說明下個學年的目標。

deer.en: A deer stood quietly near the forest path before disappearing behind the trees.
deer.zh: 一隻鹿靜靜站在森林小徑旁，之後消失在樹後。

default.en: The app uses dark mode as the default setting on this device.
default.zh: 這個應用程式在此裝置上把深色模式設為預設值。

defendant.en: The defendant listened carefully while the judge explained the next legal step.
defendant.zh: 被告仔細聽著法官說明下一個法律程序。

defensible.en: Her conclusion was defensible because it was supported by several reliable sources.
defensible.zh: 她的結論站得住腳，因為有多個可靠來源支持。

defiance.en: His quiet defiance surprised the coach, who had expected immediate agreement.
defiance.zh: 他沉默的反抗讓教練感到意外，因為教練原本以為他會立刻同意。

deficit.en: The school reduced its budget deficit by cutting unnecessary operating expenses.
deficit.zh: 學校透過刪減不必要的營運支出來縮小預算赤字。

definitive.en: Researchers said more evidence was needed before reaching a definitive conclusion.
definitive.zh: 研究人員表示，在得出明確結論前還需要更多證據。

defy.en: The tiny plant seemed to defy the harsh weather and continued growing.
defy.zh: 那株小植物彷彿無視惡劣天候，仍然持續生長。

delegation.en: A student delegation visited the city hall to learn about local government.
delegation.zh: 一個學生代表團參訪市政府，了解地方政府的運作。

delightful.en: The café had a delightful view of the river and nearby hills.
delightful.zh: 那間咖啡館可以看到河流與附近山丘，景色十分宜人。

demonstration.en: The science teacher gave a demonstration showing how air pressure affects water.
demonstration.zh: 自然老師做了一個示範，說明氣壓如何影響水。

denial.en: His denial did not match the evidence shown in the security video.
denial.zh: 他的否認與監視器影片所顯示的證據不符。

dental.en: Regular dental checkups can help identify small problems before they become serious.
dental.zh: 定期牙科檢查有助於在問題變嚴重前及早發現。

depart.en: The last train will depart from platform three at ten thirty tonight.
depart.zh: 今晚末班車將於十點半從第三月台出發。

depict.en: The mural will depict daily life in the town one hundred years ago.
depict.zh: 這幅壁畫將描繪一百年前這座小鎮的日常生活。

deploy.en: Engineers will deploy additional sensors to collect data during the field test.
deploy.zh: 工程師將部署更多感測器，在實地測試期間蒐集資料。

deputy.en: The deputy director presented the report while the director attended another meeting.
deputy.zh: 主任出席另一場會議時，由副主任提出報告。

descent.en: The hikers slowed their descent because the trail became steep and slippery.
descent.zh: 登山客因山路變得陡峭濕滑而放慢下山速度。

descriptive.en: A descriptive paragraph helps readers imagine a place through specific details.
descriptive.zh: 描述性的段落能透過具體細節幫助讀者想像一個地方。

desirable.en: Strong communication skills are desirable for students applying to the leadership program.
desirable.zh: 良好的溝通能力是申請領導培訓計畫學生的理想條件。

despair.en: The team refused to give in to despair after losing the first match.
despair.zh: 球隊在輸掉第一場比賽後拒絕陷入絕望。

desperate.en: The village was desperate for rain after several months of unusually dry weather.
desperate.zh: 經歷數月異常乾旱後，那個村莊非常渴望降雨。

despise.en: She does not despise failure because each mistake can teach something useful.
despise.zh: 她並不鄙視失敗，因為每次錯誤都可能帶來有用的學習。

dessert.en: We shared a small chocolate dessert after finishing dinner at the restaurant.
dessert.zh: 我們在餐廳吃完晚餐後一起分食了一份小巧克力甜點。

destined.en: The old theater seemed destined for closure until volunteers raised enough money.
destined.zh: 那間老戲院原本似乎注定要關閉，直到志工募到足夠資金。

destiny.en: He believed effort could shape his destiny more than luck alone.
destiny.zh: 他相信努力比單靠運氣更能塑造自己的命運。

destruction.en: The storm caused widespread destruction along the coast and damaged several roads.
destruction.zh: 暴風雨在沿海造成廣泛破壞，也損壞了數條道路。

detach.en: Please detach the form from the booklet before handing it to the teacher.
detach.zh: 請先把表格從小冊子上拆下來，再交給老師。

detain.en: Officials may detain a traveler briefly when additional identity checks are required.
detain.zh: 需要進一步身分查驗時，官員可能會短暫留置旅客。

deter.en: Clear warning signs can deter visitors from entering dangerous areas.
deter.zh: 清楚的警告標誌可以阻止遊客進入危險區域。

detergent.en: This detergent works well in cold water and leaves little residue.
detergent.zh: 這種清潔劑在冷水中效果很好，而且殘留物很少。

determination.en: Her determination helped her finish the difficult project on schedule.
determination.zh: 她的決心幫助她如期完成這項困難的專題。

devil.en: In the old story, the devil tries to trick the traveler with false promises.
devil.zh: 在那個古老故事裡，惡魔試圖用虛假的承諾欺騙旅人。

devise.en: The students worked together to devise a simpler method for collecting data.
devise.zh: 學生們合作設計出一種更簡單的資料蒐集方法。

devour.en: Hungry caterpillars can devour many leaves in a surprisingly short time.
devour.zh: 飢餓的毛毛蟲能在令人驚訝的短時間內吃掉許多葉子。

dew.en: Tiny drops of dew covered the grass early in the morning.
dew.zh: 清晨時，草地上覆蓋著一顆顆小露珠。

diabetes.en: Doctors study diabetes to improve prevention, treatment, and long-term health outcomes.
diabetes.zh: 醫師研究糖尿病，以改善預防、治療與長期健康結果。

diagnosis.en: An accurate diagnosis helps doctors choose the most appropriate treatment for a patient.
diagnosis.zh: 準確的診斷能幫助醫師為病人選擇最適合的治療方式。

dial.en: Turn the dial slowly until the radio signal becomes clear.
dial.zh: 慢慢轉動旋鈕，直到收音機訊號變清楚。

dialect.en: This dialect is spoken mainly in villages along the northern coast.
dialect.zh: 這種方言主要在北部沿海的村落中使用。

diameter.en: The diameter of the circular table is one hundred twenty centimeters.
diameter.zh: 這張圓桌的直徑是一百二十公分。

diamond.en: The museum displayed a small diamond beside other rare minerals.
diamond.zh: 博物館把一顆小鑽石與其他稀有礦物一起展出。

diaper.en: The parent packed an extra diaper in the baby's travel bag.
diaper.zh: 家長在嬰兒的旅行袋裡多放了一片尿布。

dictate.en: A single test score should not dictate every decision about a student's future.
dictate.zh: 單一次考試成績不應決定學生未來的每一項選擇。

dictation.en: The teacher used a short dictation exercise to practice spelling and listening.
dictation.zh: 老師用一段簡短聽寫練習來訓練拼字與聽力。

dictator.en: The history lesson explained how a dictator can weaken democratic institutions over time.
dictator.zh: 歷史課說明獨裁者如何可能逐漸削弱民主制度。

dictatorship.en: The documentary examined daily life under a dictatorship without praising the regime.
dictatorship.zh: 這部紀錄片探討獨裁統治下的日常生活，並未讚揚該政權。

diesel.en: The old bus uses diesel, while the newer model runs on electricity.
diesel.zh: 那輛舊公車使用柴油，而較新的車型則以電力行駛。

dig.en: The children used small tools to dig holes for the new plants.
dig.zh: 孩子們用小工具挖洞，好種下新的植物。

digest.en: It takes time for the body to digest a large meal completely.
digest.zh: 身體需要一些時間才能完全消化一頓大餐。

digestion.en: Drinking enough water can support normal digestion throughout the day.
digestion.zh: 攝取足夠水分有助於維持一整天正常的消化作用。

diligence.en: Her diligence was clear in the careful notes she reviewed every evening.
diligence.zh: 她每天晚上仔細複習筆記，顯示出她的勤奮。

dim.en: The hallway looked dim because only one small light was still working.
dim.zh: 走廊看起來很昏暗，因為只剩一盞小燈還亮著。

dime.en: He found a dime under the seat while cleaning the old car.
dime.zh: 他在清理舊車時，在座位下找到一枚十美分硬幣。

dine.en: Visitors can dine outdoors when the weather is cool and dry.
dine.zh: 天氣涼爽乾燥時，遊客可以在戶外用餐。

dinosaur.en: The museum's largest dinosaur skeleton fills most of the central hall.
dinosaur.zh: 博物館最大的恐龍骨架幾乎占滿中央大廳。

dip.en: Temperatures may dip below ten degrees during the coldest nights this week.
dip.zh: 本週最冷的夜晚，氣溫可能降到十度以下。

diplomacy.en: Careful diplomacy helped the two sides reopen talks after months of tension.
diplomacy.zh: 謹慎的外交努力幫助雙方在數月緊張後重新展開談判。

diplomatic.en: Her diplomatic reply reduced tension without avoiding the main issue.
diplomatic.zh: 她圓融的回應降低了緊張氣氛，同時沒有迴避主要問題。

directive.en: The new directive asks staff to report safety problems as soon as possible.
directive.zh: 新的指示要求員工盡快回報安全問題。

dirt.en: The shoes were covered in dirt after the students crossed the muddy field.
dirt.zh: 學生走過泥濘的田地後，鞋子上沾滿了泥土。

disable.en: You can disable notifications during class to avoid unnecessary distractions.
disable.zh: 上課時可以停用通知，以避免不必要的干擾。

disadvantage.en: A major disadvantage of the plan is its high long-term cost.
disadvantage.zh: 這項計畫的一大缺點是長期成本很高。

disappointment.en: She hid her disappointment and congratulated the winner after the final result.
disappointment.zh: 最終結果公布後，她藏起失望並向得獎者道賀。

disapprove.en: Some parents disapprove of the proposal because they think it is too expensive.
disapprove.zh: 有些家長不贊成這項提案，因為他們認為費用太高。

disastrous.en: Poor planning can have disastrous results when a project depends on strict timing.
disastrous.zh: 當專案高度依賴時間安排時，規劃不佳可能帶來災難性的結果。

disbelief.en: She stared at the final score in disbelief after the unexpected comeback.
disbelief.zh: 在意外逆轉後，她難以置信地盯著最終比分。

disc.en: The old computer still has a drive for reading a compact disc.
disc.zh: 那台舊電腦仍有可以讀取光碟的光碟機。

discard.en: Please discard damaged materials instead of returning them to the storage shelf.
discard.zh: 請丟棄損壞的材料，不要把它們放回儲物架。

discharge.en: The hospital will discharge the patient after the final examination is completed.
discharge.zh: 完成最後一次檢查後，醫院會讓病人出院。

disciple.en: The ancient text describes a disciple learning patiently from a respected teacher.
disciple.zh: 這篇古文描述一名弟子耐心向受人尊敬的老師學習。

disclose.en: Companies must disclose important risks clearly before investors make major decisions.
disclose.zh: 公司必須在投資人做重大決策前清楚揭露重要風險。

disclosure.en: Full disclosure of the study's methods allows other researchers to evaluate its results.
disclosure.zh: 完整揭露研究方法，能讓其他研究者評估其結果。

discomfort.en: He felt mild discomfort after sitting in the same position for several hours.
discomfort.zh: 他維持同一姿勢坐了數小時後，感到輕微不適。

disconnect.en: Remember to disconnect the charger before moving the device to another room.
disconnect.zh: 把裝置移到另一個房間前，記得先拔掉充電器。

discrimination.en: The school has rules against discrimination based on personal background or identity.
discrimination.zh: 學校有規定禁止因個人背景或身分而產生的歧視。

disgrace.en: He feared the scandal would bring disgrace to the organization he represented.
disgrace.zh: 他擔心這起醜聞會讓他所代表的組織蒙羞。

disguise.en: The actor wore a simple disguise so few people recognized him outside.
disguise.zh: 那位演員做了簡單偽裝，因此在外面很少有人認出他。

dishonest.en: A dishonest answer may solve a problem briefly but create larger trouble later.
dishonest.zh: 不誠實的回答或許能暫時解決問題，卻可能日後造成更大的麻煩。

dislike.en: I dislike crowded buses, so I usually leave home a little earlier.
dislike.zh: 我不喜歡擁擠的公車，所以通常會提早一點出門。

dismay.en: To everyone's dismay, the outdoor concert was canceled because of heavy rain.
dismay.zh: 令大家失望的是，戶外音樂會因大雨而取消。

dismissal.en: The manager explained that repeated rule violations could lead to dismissal.
dismissal.zh: 經理說明，反覆違規可能導致解雇。

disorder.en: The sudden power failure caused temporary disorder in the busy station.
disorder.zh: 突然停電使繁忙的車站一度陷入混亂。

dispatch.en: The office will dispatch the documents to each branch before Friday afternoon.
dispatch.zh: 辦公室會在週五下午前把文件寄送到各分部。

dispense.en: This machine can dispense drinking water when you press the blue button.
dispense.zh: 按下藍色按鈕後，這台機器就會供應飲用水。

displace.en: A major flood can displace families and damage roads, farms, and schools.
displace.zh: 嚴重洪水可能迫使家庭遷離，也會損壞道路、農田與學校。

display.en: The museum will display student artwork in the main hall next month.
display.zh: 博物館下個月將在主廳展示學生作品。

disposal.en: Proper disposal of electronic waste helps reduce pollution and recover useful materials.
disposal.zh: 妥善處理電子廢棄物有助於減少污染並回收有用材料。

dispose.en: Residents should dispose of batteries at designated recycling points rather than ordinary trash bins.
dispose.zh: 居民應把電池送到指定回收點，而不是丟進一般垃圾桶。

dispute.en: The neighbors settled their dispute by discussing the problem calmly and sharing the cost.
dispute.zh: 鄰居們透過冷靜討論問題並分攤費用，解決了爭端。

distant.en: A distant mountain range appeared clearly after the morning fog disappeared.
distant.zh: 晨霧散去後，遠方的山脈清楚地出現了。

distinctive.en: The building has a distinctive roof that makes it easy to recognize.
distinctive.zh: 這棟建築有一個很有特色的屋頂，因此很容易辨認。

distort.en: Strong reflections can distort the image and make small details hard to see.
distort.zh: 強烈反光會使影像失真，讓細節難以看清。

distract.en: Background noise can distract students who are trying to read carefully.
distract.zh: 背景噪音可能使正在專心閱讀的學生分心。

distress.en: The rescue team responded quickly after receiving a distress call from the hikers.
distress.zh: 救援隊接獲登山客的求救訊號後迅速出動。

distribution.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across different parts of the island.
distribution.zh: 這張地圖顯示島上不同地區的降雨分布。

district.en: The school district plans to renovate several older classrooms next year.
district.zh: 學區計畫明年整修幾間較老舊的教室。

diverse.en: The library offers a diverse collection of books from many cultures and fields.
diverse.zh: 圖書館提供涵蓋多種文化與領域的多元藏書。

diversity.en: Cultural diversity can enrich classroom discussions by introducing different perspectives and experiences.
diversity.zh: 文化多樣性可以透過不同觀點與經驗豐富課堂討論。

divert.en: Police may divert traffic when road repairs block the main intersection.
divert.zh: 道路施工封鎖主要路口時，警方可能會改道車流。

divide.en: Please divide the class into four groups before starting the activity.
divide.zh: 開始活動前，請把全班分成四組。

divorce.en: The novel explores how a divorce changes relationships within one family.
divorce.zh: 這本小說探討離婚如何改變一個家庭中的關係。

dizzy.en: She felt dizzy after standing up too quickly from the chair.
dizzy.zh: 她從椅子上站得太快，因此感到頭暈。

dock.en: The ferry reached the dock just before the afternoon rain began.
dock.zh: 渡輪在午後雨勢開始前剛好抵達碼頭。

doctrine.en: The course compares each doctrine with the historical conditions in which it developed.
doctrine.zh: 這門課把各種學說與其發展時的歷史條件相互比較。

documentary.en: We watched a documentary about coral reefs and changing ocean temperatures.
documentary.zh: 我們看了一部關於珊瑚礁與海洋溫度變化的紀錄片。

domain.en: This question belongs to the domain of environmental science rather than economics.
domain.zh: 這個問題屬於環境科學領域，而不是經濟學領域。

domestic.en: Domestic travel increased during the holiday because many families stayed within the country.
domestic.zh: 假期期間國內旅遊增加，因為許多家庭選擇留在國內。

dominant.en: Blue is the dominant color in the painting, covering most of the background.
dominant.zh: 藍色是這幅畫的主色，覆蓋了大部分背景。

donation.en: The library used the donation to buy new books for young readers.
donation.zh: 圖書館利用這筆捐款為年輕讀者購買新書。

donor.en: Each donor received a short report explaining how the funds were used.
donor.zh: 每位捐款人都收到一份簡短報告，說明資金如何被使用。

dose.en: The label clearly states the recommended dose for this common over-the-counter medicine.
dose.zh: 標籤清楚標示這種常見成藥的建議劑量。

doubtful.en: The coach was doubtful that the match could continue during the heavy storm.
doubtful.zh: 教練懷疑比賽是否能在暴風雨中繼續進行。

downfall.en: Poor financial decisions contributed to the company's downfall over several years.
downfall.zh: 錯誤的財務決策在數年間促成了那家公司的衰敗。

downward.en: The graph shows a downward trend in energy use since last winter.
downward.zh: 圖表顯示自去年冬天以來能源使用量呈下降趨勢。

draft.en: Please read the first draft carefully and mark any unclear sentences.
draft.zh: 請仔細閱讀初稿，並標出任何不清楚的句子。

drag.en: Do not drag the heavy box across the wooden floor.
drag.zh: 不要把沉重的箱子拖過木地板。

drain.en: Leaves can block the drain and cause water to collect after heavy rain.
drain.zh: 落葉可能堵住排水口，導致大雨後積水。

dramatic.en: The city experienced a dramatic drop in air pollution after the new policy began.
dramatic.zh: 新政策上路後，這座城市的空氣污染大幅下降。

drastic.en: The committee rejected any drastic change until more evidence became available.
drastic.zh: 在取得更多證據前，委員會拒絕任何激烈的改變。

dread.en: Many students dread oral presentations until they gain more practice and confidence.
dread.zh: 許多學生在獲得更多練習與信心前都害怕口頭報告。

drift.en: Small boats may drift away from shore when strong winds suddenly appear.
drift.zh: 強風突然出現時，小船可能會漂離岸邊。

drought.en: The long drought reduced crop yields and lowered water levels in local reservoirs.
drought.zh: 長期乾旱降低了農作物產量，也使當地水庫水位下降。

drown.en: Safety lessons teach children how to reduce the risk of drown accidents near water.
drown.zh: 安全課程教導孩子如何降低在水域附近發生溺水事故的風險。

drowsy.en: Warm air and a quiet room made several students feel drowsy after lunch.
drowsy.zh: 溫暖的空氣和安靜的教室讓幾名學生午餐後感到昏昏欲睡。

duration.en: The duration of the experiment depends on how quickly the temperature changes.
duration.zh: 實驗持續時間取決於溫度變化的速度。

dwelling.en: The archaeologists discovered an ancient dwelling near the edge of the valley.
dwelling.zh: 考古學家在山谷邊緣發現了一處古代住所。

dynamic.en: The class has a dynamic atmosphere because students often discuss ideas in small groups.
dynamic.zh: 這堂課氣氛很有活力，因為學生常以小組方式討論想法。
